body.assignment: Analyst: assess whether the frozen five-observation close-return score is a coherent daily cross-sectional short-horizon momentum specification for this 3-symbol frozen BaoStock universe. Work only from the frozen board sources (data_quality, price_profile, initial_inspection, source_contract, prices CSVs). Cover: (1) source coverage — row counts, common/union dates, duplicate/null checks, calendar-limit caveat, unadjusted close caveat (no corporate-action identification); (2) eligibility mechanics — 5 insufficient-past exclusions per symbol, 54 eligible signals, 53 with next observed close; verify these are consistent with lookback 5 over 59 observations; (3) cross-sectional score comparability — per-symbol mean/sample-SD/mean-absolute score magnitudes from initial_inspection vs per-symbol daily-return volatility in price_profile; is raw (unnormalized) return ranking comparable across symbols, and what would realized-volatility normalization change structurally (also note the signal_rule's 'positive volatility when normalized' condition); (4) assumptions embedded in the spec — direction +1 as unproven hypothesis, no max_absolute_daily_return filter, convenience sample of 3 large caps. Do NOT run any evaluation or propose changes to pass review; report evidence with exact quotes and IDs. Identify only source-supported coherence concerns, if any.
